listing.title_text_en: Sale, one bedroom apartment, 42m², Centar, Bar
listing.description_text:
U ponudi moderan stambeni kompleks savremene arhitekture, projektovan po visokim standardima gradnje i funkcionalnosti.
Objekat je spratnosti -2Po + Pr + 10, i sastoji se od dvije lamele (A i B), sa dvije podzemne etaže namijenjene garažama i ostavama. Stanarima su na raspolaganju recepcije, kao i 6 liftova, uz implementirane smart sisteme za dodatni komfor i sigurnost.
U ponudi su različite strukture stanova:
• jednosobni apartmani: 42,04 – 50,94 m²
• dvosobni apartmani: 83,18 m²
• penthausi: 103,72 – 113,23 m²
Već po cijeni 120.000€ se mogu kupiti jednosobni stanovi. U cijenu stana uključeno parking mjesto.
Kompleks se nalazi na atraktivnoj lokaciji, svega 950 m od centra Bara, na pravcu ka Ulcinju i Velikoj plaži.
listing.description_text_en:
On offer is a modern residential complex of contemporary architecture, designed according to high standards of construction and functionality.
The building has -2Po + Pr + 10 floors, and consists of two lamellae (A and B), with two underground floors intended for garages and storage rooms. Receptions are available to residents, as well as 6 elevators, with implemented smart systems for additional comfort and security.
Different apartment structures are available:
• one-bedroom apartments: 42,04 – 50,94 m²
• two-bedroom apartments: 83,18 m²
• penthouses: 103,72 – 113,23 m²
One-bedroom apartments can be purchased for prices starting from 120.000€. A parking space is included in the apartment price.
The complex is located in an attractive location, just 950 m from the center of Bar, on the way to Ulcinj and Velika plaža.

listing.title_text_en: OLEA Residence — Apartments in Bar No. 2824
listing.description_text:
Nudimo na prodaju stanove u stambenom kompleksu OLEA Residence — dvije već izgrađene zgrade u mirnom dijelu Starog Bara. Puštanje u rad i useljenje očekuju se za 1–1,5 mjesec (do sredine septembra 2026.).
Glavne karakteristike
• Površina: 51–61 m² • Sprat: po izboru — suteren (prvi), 1., 2. ili 3. (posljednji) • Visina plafona: 3 m • Grijanje/hlađenje: multi-split sistem Mitsubishi Electric (garancija 5 godina) • Prozori i vrata: aluminijumska, Braća Marić • Video nadzor na teritoriji kompleksa
O stanu
Stanovi se odlikuju visokim plafonima od 3 metra, što stvara osjećaj prostranosti, rijetkim za novogradnju ovog segmenta. Zgrada je već izgrađena — završna obrada je u toku, rok za primopredaju ključeva je minimalan u poređenju sa projektima u fazi iskopa. Razlika u cijeni između spratova odražava standardnu logiku investitora: suteren je pristupačniji po ulaznom budžetu, gornji spratovi su skuplji zbog pogleda i osvjetljenja.
Lokacija
Kompleks se nalazi u dijelu Starog Bara, blizu istorijskog dijela grada:
• apoteka "Stari Grad" — oko 220 m • supermarket Femić — oko 655 m • Starobarska pijaca — oko 850 m • autobuska stanica (Stari Bar) — oko 770 m • Stari grad Bar (tvrđava) — oko 1,1 km • more i gradska plaža — oko 2,5–3 km (5–7 minuta automobilom)
Investicioni potencijal
Skoro puštanje u rad — jedna od glavnih prednosti: kupac izbjegava tipične rizike dugotrajne izgradnje i može računati na useljenje ili izdavanje u narednim mjesecima. Blizina istorijskog centra Bara čini ove stanove interesantnim za izdavanje turistima koji posjećuju Stari grad, a raspon po površini i budžetu omogućava izbor opcije prema različitim investicionim strategijama — od kompaktnog stana za izdavanje do prostranijeg za vlastito stanovanje.
listing.description_text_en:
We offer for sale apartments in the OLEA Residence residential complex — two already built buildings in a quiet area of Old Bar. Commissioning and occupancy are expected in 1–1.5 months (by mid-September 2026).
Key Features
• Area: 51–61 m² • Floor: choice of ground (first), 1st, 2nd, or 3rd (top) • Ceiling height: 3 m • Heating/cooling: Mitsubishi Electric multi-split system (5-year warranty) • Windows and doors: aluminum, Braća Marić • Video surveillance on the complex grounds
About the Apartment
The apartments feature high 3-meter ceilings, creating a sense of spaciousness rare for new builds in this segment. The building is already constructed — finishing is in the final stage, with minimal key delivery time compared to projects at the foundation stage. The price difference between floors reflects the developer's standard logic: the ground level is more affordable for entry budget, while upper floors are priced higher due to views and natural light.
Location
The complex is located in the Old Bar area, near the historic part of the city:
• pharmacy "Stari Grad" — about 220 m • Femić supermarket — about 655 m • Old Bar market — about 850 m • bus stop (Stari Bar) — about 770 m • Old Town Bar (fortress) — about 1.1 km • sea and city beach — about 2.5–3 km (5–7 minutes by car)
Investment Potential
Quick commissioning is one of the main advantages: the buyer avoids typical long-term construction risks and can expect occupancy or rental income within the coming months. Proximity to Bar's historic center makes these apartments attractive for renting to tourists visiting the Old Town, and the range of sizes and budgets allows choosing an option for different investment strategies — from a compact rental apartment to a more spacious one for personal residence.
